scripts.title: Sir Meme Hub | [16 GAMES] [$14.99 LIFETIME] | FARM/AIM/ESP
scripts.features:
Sir Meme Hub brings 16 supported Roblox games into one premium hub for a single $14.99 payment. One licence covers every supported game, with 465 game features documented in the current catalogue. Farming, combat, ESP, movement and customization features are listed below.

No ad links or recurring key resets. Updates are included for as long as the hub is running.

SUPPORTED GAMES & FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS

RIVALS: Silent aim, ragebot with orbit/desync, skin changer for skins/wraps/charms/finishers, shareable loadouts and a live spectator panel.

Phantom Forces: Silent aim, smoothed aimbot, backtracking, hitbox controls and anti aim/fake position options.

BloxStrike: Silent aim, backtracking/wallbang, skin changer, recoil/fire rate controls and automatic rejoin when a votekick opens.

Dungeon Quest Reborn: Automatic dungeon play, ground marker dodging, automatic lobby creation/loading and run starts, plus configurable combat ranges and Discord webhook notifications.

Slayers 2: NPC/level/boss farming, automatic chest/drop pickup, item/NPC/Muzan ESP, Muzan spawn alerts and Discord webhook notifications.

Fisch: Auto fish/shake/reel, automatic bait, auto sell, fish/rarity filters with favourite preservation, and live catch/earnings status.

Command An Army: AFK match farming, automatic point capture, kill aura, troop orders/auto summoning, daily/quest rewards and enemy troop ESP.

Grand Piece Online: Automatic level/quest farming, mob gathering with retreat/resume thresholds, Fast Attacks/Auto M1, Devil Fruit/NPC/sea monster ESP and player ESP.

Guts & Blackpowder: Zombie silent aim, kill aura, melee reach/hitbox controls, expanded shove and ESP with separate colours for zombie types.

Cold War: Silent aim, configurable aimbot, recoil/fire rate/reload controls, player ESP and vehicle/turret ESP.

Emergency Response: Liberty County: Silent aim with target picker/hold target, house robbery and ATM minigame farming, recoil/spread controls, handling mods and walk speed.

Blackhawk Rescue Mission 5: Automatic mission farming with mission/difficulty selection, car travel/automatic vehicle repair, silent aim, configurable aimbot/triggerbot, gun mods and player ESP.

Operation One: Silent aim, auto fire/wallbang controls, player/gadget ESP, recoil/spread/fire rate/reload mods, chams and world visuals.

Project Delta: Silent aim/aim assist, recoil/ballistics controls, player/AI ESP, body/container/item ESP, night vision and easy climb.

Football Fusion 3: Quarterback pass redirection and separate auto throw, kicker aimbot, catch magnets/auto catch, block reach/auto swat and ball path/carrier prediction.

South Bronx: The Trenches: Location/player teleports with a method picker, saved waypoints, weapon percentage mods, respawn at your previous location, and marshmallow/box job farms.

SEE THE FULL FEATURES BEFORE BUYING

REQUIREMENTS & PURCHASE DETAILS
Windows Roblox executor required separately; an executor is not included. The website lists Volt, Potassium, Synapse Z, Madium and Real as tested. Other executors are untested. Features vary by game, and exploiting can result in bans.

One payment covers all currently supported games on one licence key. Crypto only; no refunds. Updates are included for as long as the hub is running.

scripts.title: Best OP Auto Farm Kill Aura Auto Summon Infinite Stamina
scripts.features:
Ronix Hub - Command An Army

Farm
- Auto farm, moves you onto the next enemy troop and keeps swinging
- Pick how you get there: teleport above, walk up, or drop in behind
- Height offset (2-20) and distance offset (2-15)
- Attack delay (0.01-0.5 s) and hits per cycle (1-10)
- Target priority: closest, lowest HP or frontline first
- Go after enemy troops, enemy workers, or both
- Turns you to face whatever you are hitting
- Live counters for farm status, enemies alive, allies and total hits

Kill Aura
- Hits the best enemy in range without teleporting you
- Range slider (10-100 studs)
- Its own target pick: lowest HP, closest or frontline first

Summon
- Auto summon, Summon 10 or Summon 1
- Skips the summon animation
- Stops by itself when you pull a 4-star, switch that off to keep going
- Gem reserve (0-5000), it never spends below the number you set
- Summon 10 and Summon 1 buttons
- Teleport to the summon area, open the summon menu, refresh the banner
- Shows your gems, 3-star pity out of 50, 4-star pity out of 400, luck and summon count

Teams and Map Vote
- Auto pick Attackers, Defenders, or whichever side has fewer players
- Join either side with one button, or open the team picker
- Cancel your lobby queue
- Live team count
- Auto vote for the map choice you set (1-4)
- Vote buttons that put you on the pad for each choice

Ranked
- Start or cancel the ranked queue
- Region: Auto, US East, US West, EU Central or Asia East
- Rejoin your ranked match, by hand or automatically
- Create or leave a party
- Shows your rank, RR and queue status

Rounds
- Auto join a round already in progress, or answer that prompt yourself
- Answers the Potato Mode prompt with the choice you set
- Close the match result screen
- Current state and round timer

Defense
- Auto block when an enemy within range (5-50 studs) swings at you
- Block and release buttons
- Anti stun, clears stuns and knockdowns as they land, on by default

Stamina and Movement
- Infinite stamina
- Infinite dodge roll, no cooldown and no stamina cost, Q on PC
- Auto roll while you move
- Roll speed multiplier (1-3)
- Single roll and a 5 roll burst
- Custom WalkSpeed (16-100) and RunSpeed (26-150)
- Auto sprint and sprint speed lock
- Mount or dismount your horse from the menu

ESP
- Name tags on enemy troops, your own troops and workers, each in its own colour
- Clear and reload button

Misc
- Anti AFK, on by default
- Server hop and rejoin
- Mute troop footsteps or all troop sounds
- Ping and FPS readout

Mobile friendly. Join discord.gg/ronixstudios for support and updates.

scripts.features:
# ⚔️ Command-An-Army Hub

Let the hub handle the boring parts while you focus on your army and the battle!

---

# 🏠 Main

Useful tools for moving around and seeing what's happening.

*  Speed Boost — Run faster with a boost from 0 to 15.
*  Infinite Mount Stamina — Keep your horse stamina longer.
*  Enemy ESP — See enemy players and troop count
*  Team ESP — See your teammates and troop count
*  Bird's-Eye Camera — Get a better view of the battlefield with P.

---

# 🤖 Smart Combat Automation

This is where the hub really gets to work.

Your character can automatically:

*  Mount your horse
*  Heal when your health gets low
*  Back away when enemies get too close
*  Move toward enemies and lead your troops
*  Attack nearby enemies automatically
*  Spawn fresh troops
*  Get unstuck if you become trapped
*  Detect cannons and stay slightly away

You can choose your heal and safe-distance settings, so the hub knows when it's safe to heal or when to back away.

---

# 🪖 Troop Automation

Your troops can handle combat on their own.

*  Automatically attack enemies
*  Choose how often attack commands are sent
*  Choose how troops are selected
*  Retreat when their health gets too low
*  Auto Re-spawn next troops - auto retreat when health too low

The hub also changes its behavior depending on your team.

Attackers push forward and fight.

Defenders focus on holding their position.

---

# 🏛️ Lobby Automation

The hub can handle a bunch of stuff between matches too.

* 🚪 Auto Join — Automatically join new matches.
* 🛡️ Pick Team — Choose Attackers or Defenders.
* 🗺️ Vote Maps
* 🎁 Claim Quests — Collect completed quest rewards.
* 🎲 Auto Summon — Summon warriors when you have enough gems.
* ⭐ Auto Ascend — Merge duplicate warriors to upgrade them.
* 💪 Auto Equip — Automatically equip your strongest warriors (archers not supported so script will auto remove them from equip)
* 🎟️ Redeem Codes — Claim available promo codes.

---

# 📱 Side Panel

Keep track of your army while playing.

* Shows your troop count
* Shows your army health
* Shows your current status
* 🛑 Emergency Stop — Quickly stop all automation

---

# ⚙️ Settings

Your settings are saved automatically, so you don't have to set everything up again every time you play.
